blurb: Triple Bottom Brewing is a woman-owned, certified B Corp brewery focused on beer, people, and planet. They brew a variety of balanced, creative beers including pilsners, stouts, and IPAs. The brewery hosts taproom events and offers private event spaces for groups from 20 to 140 people.
extraNote: Dietary restrictions or allergies can be accommodated with advance notice · Taproom at 915 Spring Garden, Philadelphia, PA
